description.narrative: The EU-Central America Cooperation Facility (EUreCA) supports the realisation of the potential of the Central American integration process as a driver of sustainable development in the sub-region, promoting stability, peace and the reduction of inequalities. In the spirit of international partnerships, the Facility supports regional and bi-regional dialogue, focusing on common political priorities, including green and blue recovery, digitalisation, gender equality, and the fight against inequalities. The Facility will support strategic communication activities, including large-scale public campaigns, designed to raise awareness, understanding and support for EU political priorities in Central America. It will also facilitate the design and implementation of EU actions in the sub-region, including through activities designed to build, strengthen and connect networks. Central America is the only sub-region with a fully-fledged, even if not fully ratified, Association Agreement which will remain the overarching political instrument in our political, cooperation and trade relations. While political differences between countries have slowed down the Central American integration process, it has never stopped. At technical level, it has achieved notable results in areas such as economic integration, energy and climate change. The integration process continues to be a force of stability and of positive transformation beyond national politics, and as such, must be supported. The objective of the Facility is to help nurture some of these processes, maximise their impact on the Central American countries, and to promote the EU vision of regional integration as a driver of prosperity and peace, while pursuing greater alignment with the sub-region on the strategic priorities of the EU Global Agenda. The Overall Objective (Impact) of this action is to support the bi-regional partnership between the European Union and Central America in line with the principles and objectives of the EU-CA Association Agreement, focusing on common political priorities, including green and blue recovery, digitalisation, gender equality and the fight against inequalities. These priorities are reflected in Central American instruments which advance common interests established in the EU-CA Association Agreement and the Agenda 2030: the Regional Environmental Strategy Framework which has a strong link with the Paris Agreement, the Regional Strategy for Blue Growth in the SICA countries, the Regional Digital Strategy of SICA, the Regional Policy for Gender Equality and Equity, the Integral Social Policy 2020-2040 of SICA, and the SISCA Recovery, Social Reconstruction and Resilience Plan. In particular, this action aims: 1.    To support the effective and efficient implementation of EU priorities and programmes in the sub-region, ensuring alignment with broader regional strategies. 2.    To support the Central American regional integration process as a driver of stability, peace, sustainable and inclusive development, including through public diplomacy activities designed to build, strengthen and connect regional networks.3.    To raise public awareness, understanding and support for the EU¿s values, priorities and partnership with the region, including the Team Europe approach, through strategic communication activities targeting specified audiences.
